source: HydroBASINS level 5 v1c and HydroRIVERS v1 Europe / WWF; Lehner & Grill (2013), doi:10.1002/hyp.9740
notice: Real terrain-derived hydrography, generalized for display. Reaches of Strahler order >=4 only. Basins clipped to the Nordic model domain; membership computed before display simplification. North of 60N the underlying DEM is coarser: unsuitable for farm-scale drainage. Long-term discharge is modeled 1971–2000 average, not live gauge data. Endpoint orientation uses NEXT_DOWN geometry; isolated/terminal reaches without verified direction have no flow particles.
